description_en: Removes shared resources or principals from a resource share
description_zh: 为共享单元移除共享资源或资源使用者
name: DisassociateResourceShare

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource share
parameters.name: resource_share_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the shared resource.

Valid values of N: 1 to 5. You can remove up to 5 shared resources at a time.

Resources.N.ResourceId and Resources.N.ResourceType must be used in pairs
fields.help_zh:
共享资源ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多移除5个共享资源。

Resources.N.ResourceId与Resources.N.ResourceType成对出现，需要同时设置
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the shared resource.

Valid values of N: 1 to 5. You can remove up to 5 shared resources at a time.

For more information about the types of resources that can be shared, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html.

Resources.N.ResourceId and Resources.N.ResourceType must be used in pairs
fields.help_zh:
共享资源类型。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多移除5个共享资源。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html。

Resources.N.ResourceId与Resources.N.ResourceType成对出现，需要同时设置
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The list of Alibaba Cloud Resource Names (ARNs) of the shared resources.

Valid values of N: 1 to 5. You can remove up to 5 shared resources at a time
parameters.help_zh:
共享资源ARN列表。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多移除5个共享资源
parameters.name: resource_arns

parameters.help_en:
The owner of the resource share. Valid values:

Self (default): The resource share belongs to the current account. This value applies to scenarios where a resource owner removes shared resources or principals during sharing within a resource directory.
OtherAccounts: The resource share belongs to another account. This value applies to scenarios where a principal leaves a resource share during sharing outside a resource directory
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元归属者。取值：

Self（默认值）：共享单元归属于当前账号。适用于资源目录内共享时，资源所有者移除共享资源或资源使用者场景。
OtherAccounts：共享单元归属于其他账号。适用于资源目录外共享时，资源使用者主动退出共享单元场景
parameters.name: resource_owner

ResourceShareAssociations.description_en: The information about the shared resources or principals associated with the resource share
ResourceShareAssociations.description_zh: 共享单元关联的共享资源或资源使用者信息

items.description_en: The information about the shared resources or principals associated with the resource share
items.description_zh: 共享单元关联的共享资源或资源使用者信息

AssociationStatus.description_en:
The association status. Valid values:

Associating: The association is in progress.
Associated: The association is complete.
Failed: The association failed.
Disassociating: The disassociation is in progress.
Disassociated: The disassociation is complete.

Records in the `Failed` or `Disassociated` state are automatically deleted by the system within 48 to 96 hours
AssociationStatus.description_zh:
关联状态。取值：

Associating：关联中。
Associated：已关联。
Failed：关联失败。
Disassociating：分离中。
Disassociated：已分离。

`Failed`和`Disassociated`状态的记录，会在48~96小时内被系统自动删除

AssociationStatusMessage.description_en: The reason why the disassociation failed

AssociationType.description_en:
The association type. Valid values:

Resource: the resource.
Target: the principal
AssociationType.description_zh:
关联类型。取值：

Resource：资源。
Target：资源使用者

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the disassociation is created. Two scenarios exist:

If the association type `AssociationType` is `Resource`, this parameter indicates the time when the resource is removed.
If the association type `AssociationType` is `Target`, this parameter indicates the time when the principal is removed
CreateTime.description_zh:
取消关联的时间。存在以下两种情况：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为移除资源的时间。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为移除资源使用者的时间

EntityId.description_en:
The ID of the associated entity. Valid values:

If the association type `AssociationType` is `Resource`, this parameter indicates the resource ID.
If the association type `AssociationType` is `Target`, this parameter indicates the resource directory ID, folder ID, or member ID
EntityId.description_zh:
关联实体ID。取值：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为资源ID。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为资源目录ID、资源夹ID或成员ID

EntityType.description_en:
The type of the associated entity. Valid values:

If the associated entity is a resource, this parameter indicates the resource type. For more information, see [Alibaba Cloud services that support Resource Sharing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）.
If the associated entity is a principal, this parameter is Account
EntityType.description_zh:
关联实体类型。取值：

当关联实体为资源时，该参数为资源类型。更多信息，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）。
当关联实体为资源使用者时，该参数为Account

ResourceArn.description_en:
The ARN of the associated resource.
This parameter is unavailable if the association type `AssociationType` is `Target`
ResourceArn.description_zh:
关联资源ARN。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数不可用

ResourceShareId.description_en: The ID of the resource share

ResourceShareName.description_en: The name of the resource share

TargetProperty.description_en:
The properties of the principal, such as the time period for resource sharing.
This parameter is returned only when the principal is an Alibaba Cloud service
TargetProperty.description_zh:
资源使用者属性。例如：资源共享的时间段。
仅当资源使用者为阿里云服务时返回该参数

UpdateTime.description_en:
The update time of the disassociation. Two scenarios exist:

If the association type `AssociationType` is `Resource`, this parameter indicates the update time when the resource is removed.
If the association type `AssociationType` is `Target`, this parameter indicates the update time when the principal is removed
UpdateTime.description_zh:
取消关联的更新时间。存在以下两种情况：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为移除资源的更新时间。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为移除资源使用者的更新时间
